summary_1line: Bhishma recounts Narada explaining to Krishna which Brahmanas deserve highest reverence due to their asceticism, learning, humility, charity, and devotion to Vedic duties.

image_candidates.scene_text: Narada stands with folded hands reverently worshipping a gathered circle of austere Brahmanas as Krishna watches and asks whom he honors.
Emaciated forest-dwelling Brahmanas in bark garments study the Vedas beneath the noon sun in a quiet woodland hermitage.
